title: CRLR/46/2012 of NEERAJ GUPTA Vs STATE OF UTTARAKHAND AND ORS

paras.text:
CRLR No. 46 of 2012
Hon'ble Alok Singh, J.
Mr. Navneet Kaushik, Advocate for revisionist.
Mr. S.S. Adhikari, Brief Holder for the State.
Present revision is filed challenging the order
dated 16.11.2011 passed by Judge, Family Court,
Haridwar whereby revisionist husband was directed to
pay ` 1500/ to his wife and ` 1,000/- to his minor
daughter towards monthly maintenance.
Learned counsel for the revisionist submits that
monthly income of revisionist is ` 3,500/-, therefore, out
of ` 3,500/-, ` 2500/- as monthly maintenance to wife
and minor daughter seems to be on higher side, therefore,
it may be reduced considering the monthly income of
revisionist.
Revisionist has not produced any document
showing that he is getting ` 3500/- per month.
Admittedly, earlier revisionist was working as Supervisor
in Hindustan Lever Limited, SIDCUL, Haridwar. It is
known fact that even an unskilled labour working in a
company would not get less than ` 200 per day i.e. `
6,000 per month. Even if it is presumed that revisionist is
working in a private firm as unskilled labour, even then,
he is getting not less than ` 6,000/- per month. Therefore,
maintenance granted by the trial court seems to be totally
justified. Although, this Court is conscious about the fact
that ` 2500/- per month as maintenance to wife and minor
daughter is not sufficient, but in view of the fact that
there is no petition for enhancement, therefore, no
interference is called for.
Revision fails and is dismissed. Arrears, if any,
be paid to the respondent nos. 2 and 3 within three
months from today positively.
 (Alok Singh, J.)
 31.07.2013 SKS
